Name: All-Outfit Locker
Author: BananaJoq
Description:
Description
Adds a placeable All-Outfit Locker that looks like the vanilla Joja dresser. Buy it from Pierre's shop for 1,000g starting in year 2 (season is configurable). Right-click to open the normal dresser UI and copy any vanilla hat, shirt, pants, skirt, or boots into your backpack — the catalog never runs out and the locker cannot store clothes. Dyeable clothes open a color panel on the right; click Confirm to hold the dyed item, then drop it in your inventory. Optional settings can include secret-note rares and festival-limited clothes. Vanilla clothing only; Fashion Sense and other modded IDs are skipped. Includes English and Chinese.

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Main features
- Joja-styled dresser furniture sold at Pierre's from year 2
- Vanilla dresser tabs and inventory layout
- Infinite copies of vanilla hats, shirts, pants, skirts, and boots
- Right-side dye panel with Confirm (item goes to your cursor)
- Optional filters for secret-note and festival clothes

Requirements
- SMAPI 4.1.10 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional (in-game settings)

Shout outs
Uses the vanilla Joja dresser sprite and dresser UI. Thanks to SMAPI / Pathoschild.
